metadata.description: Annotation layer for indopak-nastaleeq-wbw.json / indopak-nastaleeq.json. It never changes or re-defines the Quran text; records are keyed by the WBW location.
metadata.grammar_source: Quranic Arabic Corpus / Quranic Treebank (data/Quranic/Quranic.csv); morphology v0.4 cross-checked by validate.py
metadata.null_policy: A source value "_" means no value; the JSON key is absent. lemma_ar / root_ar hold the placeholder "ـ" in the source whenever lemma / root is absent; it is re-created on round trip, not stored.
metadata.derived_policy: Everything under a "derived" key, plus the sentence-level "constituents" list, is computed by this project from original annotations; original annotations are never replaced.

node_rules.token_id: row index inside the sentence; head and constituent spans refer to token_id
node_rules.head: Treebank ref_token_id; a root node or NonRel node points to itself
node_rules.implicit: Treebank rows without a Quranic word location (e.g. an unspoken subject); kept, not part of "words"
node_rules.anchor: implicit nodes: nearest written words before / after, so a UI can place them without altering the text
node_rules.word_in_sentence: present when a segment belongs to a word assigned to a different sentence (41 words)

source_issues.prefix_only_fragment_note: Treebank sentences that contain only the prefix segments of a word whose stem starts the next sentence (25 are two prefixes; one is a prefix plus an implicit node). They are kept (original ids and boundaries are preserved) but own no written word.
